description: Shannon is an AI pentester for web applications and APIs. It analyzes your source code, identifies attack vectors, and executes real exploits to prove vulnerabilities before they reach production.

written.description: Reads an application's source to pick its attack paths, then attacks the running web app and its API through a browser and command-line tools. A finding reaches the report only after it has been exploited.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(plugin): prepare Shannon plugin for Claude and OpenAI directory listings (#545)

* feat(plugin): prepare Shannon plugin for Claude and OpenAI directory listings

- Expand the shannon skill into a full run workflow (preflight, scoping,
  validation, start, monitor, stop, report triage, fixes) with extended
  safety rules
- Move bundled llms docs into skills/shannon/references so the skill is
  self-contained, refresh them from the repo root, add sync-docs.sh --check
- Add portable plugin.json with OpenAI listing metadata (Desktop only)
- Add Claude directory fields (icon, docs, support, privacy, terms)
- Add .agents/plugins/marketplace.json for ChatGPT and Codex
- Add square icon, safety evals, and a standalone skill zip script

* docs(plugin): use sparse marketplace installs and drop the Grok clone warning

- Claude Code and Codex install commands add --sparse so they fetch only the
  marketplace index and the plugin folder (Codex otherwise clones the full
  history on add and again on its first update)
- The Grok section keeps the direct install and drops the 15-second clone
  warning, which no longer applies once the demo GIFs leave the repository

* ci(plugin): check bundled documentation matches root originals

Run plugins/shannon/scripts/sync-docs.sh --check on pull requests and pushes
to main that touch llms.txt, llms-full.txt or the bundled copies in
skills/shannon/references/. In Actions, a mismatch or missing copy is
reported as an error annotation on the bundled file.

This is the check Ezhil drafted in 4afb058 and dropped from #524 before
review, updated for the new location of the bundled docs.

* docs(plugin): keep image paths out of the README layout block

- Anthropic's pre-submission checklist holds a plugin for review when its
  README names bundled images in a code block; describe assets/ instead
- Correct the Claude.ai upload path in build-skill-zip.sh to
  Customize > Skills, matching the README

* fix(plugin): address review feedback on the Shannon skill

- Preflight credential check accepts CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN for Anthropic
  and checks AWS_REGION, which Bedrock needs alongside its token.
- Reading results: scans --json drops a scan that ends without a report, so
  the skill now reads the outcome from status --json, covers partial, failed,
  and stopped scans, and takes the report location from reportPath.
- Drop the Node 22.7.0 warning, which no repository source backs.
- Config template comments list every login type and success condition the
  schema allows.
- sync-docs.sh rewrites relative links in the bundled llms docs to absolute
  GitHub URLs so they resolve inside the skill folder.
- homepage is keygraph.io/open-source in all three plugin manifests.
- CLAUDE.md notes that edits to the root llms docs need sync-docs.sh.
